rows.connection: Fit P11 storage, P10 cooler and compatible P9 case. P8 to Pi USB-C. P14 USB goes to ESP32 only when Pi is the chosen host.
rows.pending: Board/case/cooler fit and peripheral budget.

rows.connection: Use labelled 3V3, GND, GPIO21, GPIO22 and GPIO4 for the sensor-only map. Power through P14 USB from one host.
rows.pending: Actual DevKit pin labels, USB socket and regulator/breakout compatibility.

rows.connection: SDA to GPIO21; SCL to GPIO22; logic ground to GND; reviewed 3.3V-compatible supply. Fix rigidly to the motor casing, away from the shaft.
rows.pending: Supply terminal, onboard regulator/pull-ups and CS/SDO straps.

rows.connection: Verified VDD to 3.3V, GND to logic GND and DATA to GPIO4. Effective 4.7k pull-up DATA to 3.3V where required. Secure probe to stationary casing.
rows.pending: Supplier wire identification; do not infer function from colour.

rows.connection: Logic SDA/SCL share GPIO21/22 and logic GND. Supply only through its documented 3.3V-compatible terminal. Keep VIN+/VIN- load terminals unconnected in sensor-only assembly.
rows.pending: Shunt resistance/power, board/terminal ratings and motor startup/stall compatibility.

rows.connection: Fit matched P25 mounting and P20 guard. Leave motor leads disconnected until the exact power circuit is released.
rows.pending: Exact variant, rated/no-load/startup/stall currents and mounting drawing.

rows.connection: Keep separate from Pi/ESP32 power. Reserved for reviewed protected motor branch; no live wiring assignment yet.
rows.pending: GitHub notes existing 12V 2A as provisional; older 5A target is not an approval. Actual label/protection/polarity required.

rows.connection: Connect its USB-C plug to Pi USB-C after storage/cooling assembly; independent of the 12V motor branch.
rows.pending: Genuine compatible 5.1V/5A profile and correct plug.

rows.connection: Fit around Pi without obstructing P10 cooling, ports, storage access or cabling.
rows.pending: Case/cooler pair and clearance.

rows.connection: Fit using its instructions and connect its keyed plug to the Pi 5 dedicated fan connector.
rows.pending: Exact cooler/case fit; do not substitute a GPIO header socket.

rows.connection: Image and insert into Pi microSD slot with power disconnected.
rows.pending: Actual card capacity/authenticity and OS image.

rows.connection: Use for low-current logic/sensor rails only. Check split rails and ESP32 pin clearance.
rows.pending: Continuity of actual rails; no motor current.

rows.connection: Short secure sensor signal/supply links matching the wire schedule.
rows.pending: Header fit and continuity; not motor power wiring.

rows.connection: Computer OR Pi USB host to ESP32 USB socket. Select the actual board connector, not the UART-chip name.
rows.pending: Data capability and Micro-USB/USB-C socket match; one power source.

rows.connection: Keep available for unpowered continuity and DC-voltage/polarity checks using the instrument manual.
rows.pending: Meter model, lead sockets and range. Never place current mode directly across a supply.

rows.connection: Place one effective pull-up between DS18B20 DATA/GPIO4 and 3.3V if no suitable pull-up is already fitted.
rows.pending: Measure/identify resistor and existing module pull-ups.

rows.connection: Reserve for the adapter and reviewed DC distribution; mark actual polarity and add strain relief.
rows.pending: 5.5x2.1mm is a target, not confirmed physical fit/current rating.

rows.connection: Location and fuse are assigned with the final source/wire/driver design; keep disconnected now.
rows.pending: No fuse value assigned. Existing 10-40A assortment is not approved for this bench.

rows.connection: Mount accessible; final DC contacts/polarity join the reviewed motor branch only.
rows.pending: DC load/startup rating; an ordinary inline switch is not a certified emergency stop.

rows.connection: Secure to the bench around actual rotating parts with suitable clearance and service access.
rows.pending: Guard dimensions/fixings and fit; no electronic guard-status feedback exists.

rows.connection: Keep VM, motor outputs and logic controls unassigned until board schematic and motor-current compatibility are established.
rows.pending: Exact module/continuous current/peak duration/thermal limits and startup-disable control. Current firmware has no driver control.

rows.connection: Install only the network specified by the final driver board/reference circuit.
rows.pending: Capacitor and TVS values/ratings/topology pending; no default diode across a reversible H-bridge motor.

rows.connection: Cut/terminate only after gauge, length, fuse and terminal sizes are coordinated.
rows.pending: 18AWG is a candidate, not an approved size for unknown current/length.

rows.connection: Mount and label positive/return points for the final motor circuit; keep motor return separate from signal-return routing.
rows.pending: Exact current/wire/voltage ratings, covers and termination instructions.

rows.connection: Secure motor on a stable non-slip base using its actual mounting pattern and permissible screw depth.
rows.pending: Generic 25mm/370 names do not establish screw fit or depth.

rows.connection: Leave disconnected unless an identified 5V accessory needs it and its branch is designed.
rows.pending: Not Pi default power; no parallel USB/buck power to ESP32.

rows.connection: Leave out of a verified 3.3V bus. Add only for a documented incompatible peripheral and reviewed pull-ups.
rows.pending: Peripheral voltage and translator schematic.

rows.connection: Leave out while ESP32 onboard USB-UART is used. A separate UART setup requires verified 3.3V levels and one power source.
rows.pending: Not RS-232; no assumed VCC connection or simultaneous driving of the same UART.

rows.connection: Place only in its documented compatible DC measurement location after branch ratings/terminals are approved.
rows.pending: Latest source specifies a DC meter, not an arbitrary USB-only meter.

rows.connection: Label and store disconnected; commission separately when replacing a part.
rows.pending: Record actual spare identity; do not parallel-connect spares or duplicate an active device identity.
